_comment: OrionLayer's OWN wording for the research CHANGE screen (wire id 36, the engine's own SCREEN_TECH_CHANGE). Everything the GAME says comes from the player's files instead - the field and application names from TECHNAME.LBX (core/technames.py) and the panel's words from BILLTEXT.LBX (core/billtext.py). What is here is the wording OrionLayer owns: a title the original paints into TECHSEL art rather than printing, and the sentences it says when it cannot draw the list (decision 15 - a renderer draws what it is handed and does not know the words).
entry_boxes_note: The eight entry boxes carry NO SKIN. They wore the inner_panel ARTWORK until work order 166 part C, and Data's verdict on the live panel was that it does not fit them: they are drawn in code now, the way screens/planets/ draws its boxes - one fill and one rounded outline through Style.draw_plate, which is the helper the Planets screen and the colony list already share (core.researchpanel.draw_box). A box with no skin draws nothing of its own, which is what lets the drawing live where the rest of the panel's drawing lives. Marked inner_boxes_drawn in screen.py.
title: CHANGE CURRENT RESEARCH
title_note: HD EXTENSION. The original's headline is part of the TECHSEL.LBX panel art (picture 14 in change mode, tech.cpp:153) and is not a string tech.cpp prints, so there is nothing to transcribe - doc/tech_change_reading.md section 3 has the panel's own labels as NOT SETTLED. The WORDING is help 255's own title, 'Change Current Research', which is the game's name for this screen. Marked in screen.py and held by a smoke check.
exit_label_note: DEVIATION. The original paints this word into the button art - TECHSEL.LBX picture 0x1B, loaded at tech.cpp:176 and passed to Add_Button_Field_(_g_scrn_x + 0xBD, _g_scrn_y + 0x1C4, "", ..., "\x1B", '(') at :208-210 with an EMPTY label string. So there is no string tech.cpp prints for HD to transcribe, exactly as with the panel's category labels, and the WORD is the one the art itself shows: read off the native frame at the rectangle the wire reports, (269,452)-(360,470), in ~/orionlayer-fixtures/evidence/work_order_165/D_overlay_4/. Printed as text until the artwork is extracted. Marked in screen.py and held by a smoke check.
